#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

class B {
private:
    istream* is;
    ostream* out;
    static const bool oj = false; // Set to true for online judge

    void solve() {
        int n;
        (*is) >> n;
        string s;
        (*is) >> s;
        vector<char> svec(s.begin(), s.end());
        
        bool inner = false;
        int len = 0;
        int max1 = 0;
        int num2 = 0;

        for (char c : svec) {
            if (c == '_') {
                if (inner) {
                    if (len > 0) num2++;
                } else {
                    max1 = max(max1, len);
                }
                len = 0;
            } else if (c == '(') {
                if (inner) {
                    if (len > 0) num2++;
                } else {
                    max1 = max(max1, len);
                }
                inner = true;
                len = 0;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                if (inner) {
                    if (len > 0) num2++;
                } else {
                    max1 = max(max1, len);
                }
                inner = false;
                len = 0;
            } else {
                len++;
            }
        }

        if (inner) {
            if (len > 0) num2++;
        } else {
            max1 = max(max1, len);
        }

        (*out) << max1 << " " << num2 << endl;
    }

    void run() {
        if (oj) {
            is = &cin;
            out = &cout;
        } else {
            is = &cin;
            out = &cout;
        }

        long long start = 0;
        if (!oj) {
            start = clock();
        }
        
        solve();
        out->flush();
        
        if (!oj) {
            cerr << (clock() - start) << "ms" << endl;
        }
    }

public:
    B() {
        is = &cin;
        out = &cout;
    }
    
    void run_public() {
        run();
    }
};

int main() {
    B solver;
    solver.run_public();
    return 0;
}
